title: Fourier homogeneity
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. The function is Fourier homogeneous of degree $k$ if every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ is indexed by a subset of size $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
